items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Cecil Scott brought a group in there.

ctx.x: And when we graduated from grammar school and from high school, we were always supposed to go to Atlanta, Georgia, to go to the Morehouse University because they had a big, beautiful -- they had a mixed curriculum there for students. And he went to Morehouse, and I went to Wilberforce. So they could --
Yeah, Cecil Irwin (unintelligible) went to Morehouse, and I went to Wilberforce -- Wilberforce University.
